claims.title: Use deterministic modules for market measurements

rule.summary: Precise market measurements come from the runtime modules; narrative context cannot replace them.
constraints: report unavailable evidence after the retry

failure.meaning: A measurement without its deterministic source cannot support a pass or fail.

missing.meaning: Missing module evidence remains explicit and is never fabricated.

rule.summary: The standard eligibility route starts only in a confirmed Stage 2 advance.

failure.meaning: A known non-Stage-2 classification cannot proceed to deep entry analysis.

missing.meaning: Unknown lifecycle evidence does not become a rejection or a pass.

claims.title: Standard eligibility requires all eight Trend Template criteria

rule.summary: All eight criteria are an AND gate for the standard route.

criteria.requirement: close is above the 150-day and 200-day averages
200-day average is rising over the prior month
50-day average is above the 150-day and 200-day averages
close is at least 30 percent above the 52-week low
close is within 25 percent of the 52-week high
relative strength meets the required minimum

failure.meaning: One known failed criterion rejects the standard route, including price below a falling 200-day average.

missing.meaning: Missing criteria remain unresolved unless another route is explicitly eligible.

claims.title: Recent IPOs use a separate Primary Base route only when long history is unavailable

rule.summary: Use the Primary Base route only when long moving-average history is insufficient; it never waives a known standard-gate failure.
conditions: at least two months of trading history
primary base is at least three weeks
a three-week base is no deeper than 25 percent
a three-to-five-week base is no deeper than 35 percent
a base lasting about one year may be as deep as 50 percent
breakout is to an all-time high

failure.meaning: A known standard-gate failure or failed Primary Base condition rejects the IPO route.

missing.meaning: Ambiguous base quality requires needs_chart and cannot pass before review.

provenance.resolution: history absence permits the route; known failure does not

claims.title: VCP qualification requires evidence of contracting supply

rule.summary: A VCP is evidence that supply has contracted toward a line of least resistance; a pattern name alone is insufficient.

failure.meaning: Known absent contraction cannot qualify as a VCP-based setup.

missing.meaning: Unquantified supply or pattern quality remains needs_chart.

provenance.resolution: wait for evidence rather than infer from a label

claims.title: Power Play can narrow the fundamentals requirement but cannot waive other controls

rule.summary: A qualifying Power Play may proceed despite weak or unavailable verified growth data only when technical eligibility, VCP quality, market alignment, and risk controls remain intact.
conditions: advance is at least 100 percent in under eight weeks
flag lasts three to six weeks and at least twelve trading days
flag declines no more than 25 percent
flag is no more than 10 percent tight or has clear VCP characteristics

failure.meaning: A failed non-fundamental control or a material integrity defect rejects the exception.

missing.meaning: Missing Power Play evidence cannot create a third eligibility route.

provenance.resolution: exception is policy-scoped, not a technical waiver

claims.title: Prospective entries require defined downside and asymmetric reward

rule.summary: Set an initial stop no wider than half the realized average gain and never beyond ten percent; aim for ordinary losses near six to seven percent and require at least two-to-one expected reward to risk.
constraints: initial stop is no wider than half average gain
initial stop is no wider than 10 percent
average loss target is six to seven percent
expected reward to risk is at least 2 to 1

failure.meaning: Undefined or excessive risk prevents a prospective entry.

missing.meaning: Missing entry, stop, or reward evidence prevents an asymmetric-risk claim.

provenance.resolution: no setup exception widens planned loss

claims.title: Hard stops execute and losing positions are not averaged down

rule.summary: Execute a hard stop without widening it, and add only after price confirmation rather than averaging down.

failure.meaning: A breached stop requires exit evidence; a proposed add below confirmation is blocked.

missing.meaning: Without current price or stop evidence, risk status is unresolved.

provenance.resolution: market hostility tightens risk or returns to cash

claims.title: Profits are protected once a position reaches three R

rule.summary: At three R, protect at least breakeven; profits remain capital and a meaningful gain is not allowed to become a loss.

failure.meaning: A position that reached three R without breakeven-or-better protection violates the risk spine.

missing.meaning: Without initial risk and the maximum favorable excursion, the three-R threshold is unknown.

provenance.resolution: paid risk must not revert to a loss

claims.title: Early entries carry explicit confirmation debt

rule.summary: An early entry is opt-in after technical eligibility and must disclose the unpaid confirmation, later pivot or breakout, exact invalidation, and elevated false-positive risk.

failure.meaning: An early entry without its confirmation debt and invalidation is not an executable setup.

missing.meaning: Missing future confirmation or exact invalidation leaves the tactic unresolved.

provenance.resolution: cannot bypass canonical qualification or supply absorption

claims.title: 21 EMA and 50 SMA have distinct management roles

rule.summary: Use the 21 EMA for the default swing-management lens and a selected 50 SMA trail for position management; both use two completed closes below the selected average. Neither substitutes for 50/150/200 eligibility averages.
rule.trigger: two completed closes below the selected management average

failure.meaning: A role-swapped moving-average interpretation cannot support the stated management conclusion.

missing.meaning: Missing selected management average or context prevents a mechanical management reading.

provenance.resolution: eligibility and management averages are not interchangeable

claims.title: Weakly sourced Chapter 12 failure cascade remains non-executable

rule.summary: This cascade is retained for audit only and must not generate an execution rule or verdict.

failure.meaning: No failure effect is executable while the source remains quarantined.

missing.meaning: Missing evidence does not promote a quarantined rule.

provenance.basis: source extraction is too weak for execution
provenance.resolution: retain as quarantine pending source verification

quarantine.reason: Evidence quality is insufficient for an executable rule.
